escena: SCENE photographed in the Efeonce digital studio, hard neutral daylight raking in from a low window at frame left, physically motivated light with crisp small shadows, no amber cast, modern digital tools. The upper 38 percent is an unbroken smooth graphite plaster wall in deep shadow for white advertising typography to be composed later, no beams, objects or figures in that area. All action is concentrated between 42 and 78 percent of frame height, large enough to understand on a phone. Only one small Codex figure, exact proportions and silhouette of its reference, photographed as a real tactile physical 25cm object, with contact shadows. No people. No paper, no books, no coffee mugs, no company wordmarks, no fabricated logos, no legible screen text. Blue comes from the navy equipment and the figurine, orange is a single physical functional detail, never a global filter. No holograms. Precise real optical texture, sophisticated commercial photography, not CGI. The Codex figure is bent over a dark landscape tablet on a navy workbench. Three narrow illuminated translucent glass tiles rise physically only a few centimetres from slots in a dark aluminium reader: one is lit from below, two remain dim. The figure is reaching toward the single lit tile, caught before touching it. These are tangible small components with edges and contact shadows, not floating cards or holograms, no letters and no symbols on the tiles. The reader built into the table is the visible low cool light source: it illuminates the fingertips and lower visor from below without tinting the wall. A tiny orange physical latch on the device is the one accent. Table-height perspective, close 70mm optical lens, asymmetrical large triangular arrangement. The tablet stand is anodised active blue #0375DB metal, clearly visible as a functional blue object independently of the mascot, never a background panel.
fuente: the cool illuminated glass slots in the low aluminium tablet reader on the tabletop
